body.resume_text: Hasan A. - AI Researcher & Educator | Open-Source Developer | Arabic NLP Specialist Building the Future of Language Understanding 📧 hasan@learnwithhasan.com | 🌐 LearnWithHasan.com | 💼 GitHub/Twitter: @hassancs91 --- ### Summary Self-taught researcher and educator with 15+ years in tech, specializing in AI tool development, Arabic NLP, and educational platforms. Proven track record of building open-source libraries (SimplerLLM), scaling EdTech projects (1M+ YouTube subscribers, 110K+ Udemy students), and pioneering research on language-optimized LLMs. Passionate about redefining how machines understand meaning through character-level semantics and morphologically aware models. --- ### Key Research & Projects SimplerLLM (Open-Source) - Unified Python library for multi-provider LLM interaction, used by developers to build AI agents and tools. - Features: Streamlined API, multi-model support, and tools for semantic search/RAG workflows. DeepArabic (Research Initiative) - Advancing Arabic NLP through letter-level semantic embeddings and root-based models to address underrepresentation in AI. - Key focus: Morphological analysis, custom tokenization, and intuitive evaluation methods (e.g., letter arithmetic). TubeDigest.com - AI-powered YouTube companion generating structured educational content (summaries, quizzes, Q&A) from videos. - Built with Python/FastAPI, serving 50K+ monthly users. EdTech Platforms - Grew LearnWithHasan.com to 110K+ students via courses on AI, Python, and self-hosting. - Launched 20+ Udemy courses on IT infrastructure (Active Directory, VMware) with 4.8/5 avg ratings. --- ### Technical Expertise AI/ML: LLM Architecture Design, Custom Tokenization, Vector DBs (Qdrant), Semantic Embeddings Dev: Python, FastAPI, Docker, MongoDB, WordPress, JS Infra: Self-Hosting, VPS, VMware, Windows Server NLP: Arabic Morphology, Tokenization, Letter-Level Semantics --- ### Career Journey 2010–2016: IT Infrastructure Specialist (Active Directory, VMware, RDS) 2017–Now: Full-Time Educator & Developer | Created top-rated Udemy courses and YouTube channel (1M+ subs). 2020–Now: Shifted focus to open-source AI tools and research on Arabic NLP, launching SimplerLLM and DeepArabic. --- ### Current Research Directions - Character-Level LLMs: Treating characters (not tokens) as semantic building blocks for cross-linguistic understanding. - Arabic-Centric Models: Developing lightweight, interpretable architectures using morphological rules and root-based embeddings. - Evaluation Innovation: Designing tests like \\\"letter arithmetic\\\" to measure true semantic grasp in AI systems. --- ### Open-Source & Advocacy - Advocate for self-hosting and transparent AI; maintain 10+ repos on GitHub. - Built PowerKit.dev (micro-SaaS tools) and PromoterKit.com (SEO/content AI). --- ### Let’s Collaborate Seeking partnerships with labs/companies prioritizing: - Language-specific LLM innovation (especially Arabic) - Open-source AI tooling and research - Ground-up rethinking of tokenization and evaluation paradigms Available for advisory roles, research collaborations, or prototyping projects. --- Footer: Portfolio & Code: LearnWithHasan.com | GitHub: @hassancs91 | X: @h-educate --- Why This Works: 1. Research-First Narrative: Highlights Hasan’s unique value in Arabic NLP and LLM architecture. 2. Quantified Impact: Uses metrics (1M+ subs, 110K+ students) to validate influence. 3. Clear Technical Hierarchy: Separates AI/ML, dev, and infra skills for quick scanning. 4. Alignment with Labs/Teams: Targets orgs valuing open-source, language-specific models, and applied research. 5. Storytelling: Maps his journey from IT to AI innovator, showing adaptability and vision.
